newSites.name: ILLINOIS
newSites.desc: Illinois resident suspected of contracting hantavirus after cleaning a rodent-infested property per The Daily Beast (13 May); health officials believe exposure via aerosolized rat urine or feces. Case assessed as unrelated to MV Hondius outbreak; local and state health authorities investigating.

site.name: M/V HONDIUS
site.desc: WHO confirmed 9 cases and 3 deaths linked to vessel as of 13 May; evacuations confirmed complete per WHO. Vessel en route Rotterdam with 30 skeleton crew + Dutch nurse for full decontamination.

site.name: CALIFORNIA
site.desc: CDPH monitoring one returned Hondius traveler via daily temperature checks and symptom assessment. A second California resident transited Tenerife to Nebraska NQU via CDC/HHS biocontainment charter. No California residents reported ill as of 13 May. Acting CDC Director Bhattacharya criticised on CNN for vague responses on hantavirus passenger monitoring procedures per The Daily Beast.

site.name: GEORGIA
site.desc: Two American Hondius passengers transferred to Emory University Hospital SCDU in Atlanta for monitoring as of 12 May per Axios; two additional Georgia residents asymptomatic and following CDC guidance at home. Emory stated no public risk anticipated; SCDU, established 2002, is one of few US facilities capable of treating dangerous communicable diseases.

site.name: NEBRASKA
site.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC NQU received Dr. Stephen Kornfeld (Oregon oncologist, PCR-positive, isolated awaiting confirmation per AP 13 May) after he assisted ill Hondius passengers aboard; a second symptomatic American also in biocontainment. 17 Americans repatriated via State Dept airlift from Tenerife to Offutt AFB; CDC says widespread US transmission unlikely.

descChanges.prevDesc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit (NQU) received two Americans in biocontainment units: one asymptomatic PCR-positive per AP News 11 May, one symptomatic per The Daily Beast — travel content creator Jake Rosmarin among those quarantined, reporting feeling safe under medical care. 17 Americans total repatriated via State Dept airlift from Tenerife to Offutt AFB; CDC says widespread US transmission unlikely.

site.name: MANILA
site.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none currently ill as of 13 May. Skeleton crew of ~30 (predominantly Filipino) will remain aboard to sail vessel to Rotterdam with Dutch nurse. Monitoring continues through incubation window.
